dispositions.resolution: Legacy model, manifest, CSV and validation outputs classify the source authority and reject every destination within a legacy run root; validation no longer attaches to legacy summary state.
The leader-owned DynamicCapacityService now composes persisted observations, reservations, PBS submission/reconciliation, replacement and exact admission.
TerminalService implements configured close policies, durable drain/proposal deadlines, preclose admission and bounded terminal merge through the shared merge service.
Legacy SQLite paths are URI-quoted, opened mode=ro/query_only with the retained timeout, and reserved-character paths are tested.
The Checker drift fixture is synthetic rather than dependent on a deleted HEAD path; clean committed targets passed the full suite.
P3 operational checks were rebound to retained authority/dynamic-capacity/schema owners and are included in the P5 PBS/checker gate.
Boundary and P4 migration verification explicitly project the authorized P5 deletions while retaining semantic drift counterexamples.
Legacy downgrade requires legacy-exclusive keys; malformed current v4 snapshots fail closed and P4-era envelopes are projected explicitly.
P5-FRAGMENT, P5-ARCH and LEGACY-01 have implementation/test owners, complete matrix rows and clean target structured evidence; the phase requirement Checker passes.
Dead candidate outbox DDL/mutators and phase1 performance helper were deleted; PBS scheduling is now consumed by the unified dynamic service.
Adoption rules moved to one torch-free core implementation shared by config and runtime validation.
Deleting classic-only probes was correct; current-v4 crash and paired-performance harnesses are explicit P6 deliverables and are not P5 runtime compatibility surface.
The helper was renamed/documented as repository files while tracked-evidence verification remains a separate strict Git check.
URI quoting and the 60-second SQLite timeout were restored with reserved-path coverage.
Removed-table tests inspect sqlite_master and retained-config checks cover every removed key.
Observability and repository/module documentation were synchronized with the retained shims and packages.
runtime/services now owns merge, dynamic capacity and terminal orchestration with documented dependency direction.
Miyabi-compatible qstat summary listing followed by bounded per-job detail queries replaces the unsupported qstat -f-without-job form.
Authority schema 8 persists terminal deadlines and terminal merge consumption under the close generation fence.
A fenced preclose state persists the immutable cutoff and visibility deadline before scanning.
All bounded terminal waits sleep min(remaining, scan interval).
CSV output independently reclassifies the named authority and rejects absent or forged protocol labels.
Terminal command IDs hash printable bounded reasons instead of embedding operator text.
Scale-out planning excludes every stream with an unreleased reservation and handles planning fences without crashing the leader.
Scheduler transition identity includes persisted row version and evidence so a new observation cannot replay a stale command result.
P4-era v4 envelopes are recognized strictly and fully projected after eligibility, preserving query-only access without broad downgrade.
The obsolete P4 script that forged a launch request was deleted; leader-authorized dynamic replacement is covered by current service tests and is the P6 G9 successor path.
Clean target runtime and structured requirement evidence are bound to 57fd2bef with git_dirty=false.
Merge attempts return distinct no-batch and fence-conflict states; terminal conflict retries do not consume the durable merge budget.
Operator files receive durable content dispositions and are removed from the hot scan only after exact no-follow revalidation.
Production capacity observations persist the actual selected-contributor width from the shared merge service.
Post-P5 boundary projection is narrow and the baseline protocol exemption is byte-bound to an exact SHA-256.
Tests cover terminal launch-budget closure, visibility, bootstrap admission through runtime, merge outcomes and dynamic-capacity policy branches.
Selection command IDs use leader epoch and deterministic local sequence without a random suffix.
Malformed admission observations enter the existing deferred telemetry path; valid preclose requests are cutoff-checked by persisted registration timestamps.

The CLI collision now returns an actionable parser error and malformed requests remain safely ignored; adding a separate malformed-request telemetry schema is non-blocking observability work, not a P5 safety gap.

Protocol classification must open the named authority instead of trusting a manifest label; checkpoint-only directories without authority are not a supported run-root query source. Reopening is bounded constant work and preserves the independent guard at each output mutation boundary.

Operations docs now state leader-generated exact launch identity for dynamic replacement; compatibility docs state schema 6 is preserved evidence with no in-place resume/migration, while the strict P4-era query projection is tested.
The secondary processed archive was removed, eliminating symlink/path-length publication; durable disposition precedes exact hot-entry unlink.
Regular operator files are streamed in 64 KiB chunks with at most 1 MiB+1 retained bytes and full digest/identity verification.
